name: Hallowed Memorandum
label: Quest
description: Hallowed Memorandum: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, another gnome comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
